Source_Title: Panel 'Kepulangan ke Tanahair' (the voyage home, 1977)
Author_or_Organisation: Royal Malaysian Navy (TLDM) display on board KD Hang Tuah
Document_Reference: Photograph IMG_8987.HEIC (iPhone 16), taken on board KD Hang Tuah, 30 September 2026, centre panel
Rights_Status: Panel content belongs to its producer. Photograph unpublished pending the project owner's review.
Verification_Notes: Panel text documents: departure from Portsmouth 15 Aug 1977 at 3.00 pm; calls at Jeddah (10–17 Sep, Umrah and Hari Raya Aidilfitri), Abu Dhabi, Muscat and Colombo; arrival at Port Klang 14 Oct 1977 at 9.00 am; Malacca 16–17 Oct; Woodlands 18 Oct 1977. The panel map additionally labels Casablanca, Tunisia and Alexandria (no dates) and gives planned ETA/ETD times. The map label 'Abu Dabi, Saudi Arabia' is geographically wrong (Abu Dhabi is in the UAE). Producer and date of the panel are not shown. Claims on this panel are marked Verified only where the panel text states them directly.

Source_Title: HMS Mermaid
Verification_Notes: Ordered by Ghana as Black Star; about £5 million; launched without ceremony 29 Dec 1966; Type 41/61 basis, flush deck, single funnel; Mk XIX twin 4 in, four 40 mm, Squid mortar; sonars 170 and 176; 2,300 tons; 24 knots; complement 177; to Portsmouth April 1972, Chatham refit; commissioned 16 May 1973; based in Singapore; stood by for Saigon evacuation; Fittleton collision; Cod Wars; MTI radar trials; transferred April 1977 keeping F76.

Source_Title: F 76 HMS Mermaid
Verification_Notes: Launched 29 Dec 1966; commissioned 16 May 1973; transferred April 1977; training ship 1992; 1995–97 refit. Internally inconsistent on displacement (2,300 vs 2,340 t) and crew (177 vs 210).
